description: Text statistics for a web page's visible content: word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, Flesch reading-ease score and top keywords (stop words removed). Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
